description.en: Plugins that give DeepSeek Harness bounded per-session project memory and an on-demand long-term user/credential vault.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 提供「有界的会话项目记忆 + 按需读取的长期用户/凭据记忆」的插件索引。

description.en: Per-turn project memory (<=600 chars, auto-injected per session) + long-term identity/credentials vault ($DSH_HOME, on-demand skill + vault_read, tiered outbound-only leak guard). Zero dependencies, host-only.
description.zh: 每回合后台整理项目记忆（单条≤40、同对话≤600 字，自动注入当前会话）+ 长期身份/账号密码（$DSH_HOME，skill 按需读取、分级外发护栏）。零依赖、host-only。
